capabilities: Start and stop a local VitePress dev server from the sidebar and open it in the browser
Copy the current document to the VitePress srcDir and preview it
Run build, preview, and publish commands for the static site
Configure custom dev, build, and preview commands for other static site generators
Select which top-level directories or files get published
extras: README links to separate Chinese documentation; publishing requires a locally installed and configured VitePress site with paths set in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to preview or publish notes through a local static site generator like VitePress.

relations.evidence: preview and compile your .md files using VitePress

requires.name: VitePress (or another static site generator) installed locally

summary: Publishing plugin that previews and builds vault Markdown with a local VitePress dev server, with configurable commands for other static site generators.
